# 2 Baruch Chapter 60 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**60:1** "And-those-black-waters which-you-saw coming-after-the-second-bright-waters: these-are-the-sins-which-all-the-generation-of-your-fathers sinned before-the-LORD, and-they-were-worse-than-the-sins-which-the-first-generation-had-sinned."

**60:2** "For-they-forsook the-Most-High, and-they-corrupted-his-statutes, and-they-abandoned his-ways, and-went-after-the-works-of-their-hands, and-they-served idols; and-all-these-evil-things were-done-by-them-in-the-time-of-their-generation."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
